[[Al-Nassr FC|Al-Nassr]] won the league title after beating city neighbours [[Al-Riyadh SC|Al-Riyadh]] in the final. ==Overview== The end of season playoffs were changed to one-legged affairs from the previous home-and-away two-legged matchups. Allowed the team record 3 foreign players in this year, and preparations for the national team camps.
